title: High-Speed Crash Happens In Front Of Trooper
description: The incident occurred January 22, 2023. There were no injuries.

transcript.text: This high-speed crash happened right in front of a Minnesota State Trooper, and she is not going to waste a second to urgently respond to help this motorist. Take a look, because she's about ready to fly. I just went into 1050 into the guardrails, northbound 169, just north of Bloomington. I'm going to flip for it. I've got it, northbound south of 494 on the median. On seat, 636. Oh, yep, that was kind of scary. There were no injuries in this incident thanks to the median cable barrier, which absorbed the impact and helped prevent the chance of a horrific head-on crash.
